title: Frank Drake's Project Ozma

tellings.quote: >> In 1961, legendary astronomer Frank Drake started project Ozma, the first ever organized search for interstellar radio signals.

plain: In 1961, says Michels, the astronomer Frank Drake started Project Ozma, the first organized search for radio signals from other stars. Michels tells it himself as background in an episode with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel. It marks the start of scientists looking seriously for intelligent life elsewhere.
